NEETS BAY TERMINAL HARVEST AREA COMMERCIAL TROLL FISHERY ANNOUNCEMENT

The following information details the Southern Southeast Regional Aquaculture Association (SSRAA) Neets Bay Terminal Harvest Area (THA) commercial troll fishery open waters.

The Neets Bay THA will close to commercial trolling in those waters east of the Inner-Bay line at 11:59 p.m., Monday, July 13, 2026. The Inner-Bay line is described as 55°47.78′ N lat, 131°31.21′ W long, to 55°46.93′ N lat, 131°31.21′ W long (Figure 1).

These waters are being closed to allow SSRAA to collect fish for broodstock needs. Broodstock collection is scheduled to begin Tuesday, July 14.

Chinook Salmon Landing Restrictions for Neets Bay THA: Chinook salmon retention and possession in the Neets Bay THA is prohibited for vessels operating commercial troll gear within the THA.

The Emergency Order corresponding to this announcement is EO 1E2026.
